title: The House of Harrow Glen
author: Mara Zhou
blurb: August Halloran, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the harvest moon rises.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
